text:
alice: Quick sync  post-launch telemetry + customer asks for v3 feature set. We need to decide bug vs enhancement for the follow-on sprint.
rafael: short context  two enterprise customers reported increased failures on the new streaming path (cust-zoe, cust-t2). CS says they're seeing retries and session resets.
kim: plus product ask: a subset of customers requested deterministic sampling control (enhancement) for better UX. Not breaking, but high-value.
oliver: my read: reliability regressions should be bug-first for SLA orgs. Deterministic sampling is an enhancement that could be batched into next cycle.
alice: propose rubric: if customer-facing failure >0.4% sustained >30m OR any SLA org impacted -> classify as BUG and slot into hotfix sprint; else classify as ENH and put in roadmap grooming.
rafael: agree. Also add "repro in perf harness" as tie-breaker for prioritizing infra-led fixes.
cs_bot: [notice] Ticket 9123 opened for cust-zoe: retries=12 in 45m, severity=medium.
kim: timeline-wise: we can do a targeted hotfix for the streaming path in 1 day if we divert a backend engineer; a full infra fix would be 2-3 sprints.
oliver: budget impact: hotfix = minor CPU increase (+~3% cost) for affected orgs; full fix = engineering 2.5 sprint-weeks.
alice: decision: Rafael + Oliver own mitigation. Push targeted hotfix to flagged orgs and run 1h canary. If canary <0.25% failure and latency delta <6% -> keep mitigation and schedule infra fix as P1 next sprint. Deterministic sampling moves to backlog grooming pool.
rafael: will deploy targeted hotfix now and post canary results.
kim: I'll add deterministic sampling to the enhancement board with proposed specs and customer examples.
alice: thanks. Meeting 11:00 PT to review canary results and finalize backlog placement. Short update after canary pls.
